independentReview.notes: Every spoken sentence reviewed against canonical English short reader for clear newcomer meaning, source grounding, curiosity and emotional intent. sentenceIntentions.text: What happens to pride when excellent work no longer feels entirely your own?
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Connect assisted achievement with unsettled pride
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel a familiar emotion become difficult to place

sentenceIntentions.text: Autopsy of Future Emotions explores the emotional side of living and working with AI.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the book's emotional focus on AI
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand the inquiry extends beyond productivity

sentenceIntentions.text: Its questions reach beyond jobs into how we recognize skill, sincerity, usefulness, and belonging.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Expand the stakes to sincerity, usefulness and belonging
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize social meanings behind technological change

sentenceIntentions.text: A familiar feeling can become strange when the situation producing it has never existed before.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Explain how old feelings encounter new situations
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Become curious without expecting claims of instant psychological rewiring

sentenceIntentions.text: The book considers work done with AI, changing professional lives, and bonds with artificial companions.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name concrete settings of work and artificial companionship

sentenceIntentions.text: It explores possible feelings without pretending that imagined futures are established facts.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Keep future scenarios separate from established psychology
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Trust the uncertainty of the exploration

sentenceIntentions.text: Experiences left out of arguments about productivity begin to acquire names.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Give unnamed experiences a place in the inquiry
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want language for feelings that productivity debates miss

sentenceIntentions.text: Start with work and recognition, and consider what technical progress might ask us to feel.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Point to work and recognition as the beginning
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Consider which emotional expectations progress may unsettle
